en-US.author: CAST AI Group, Inc.
en-US.description: A terminal coding agent powered by multi-model orchestration.
en-US.longDescription: Kimchi is a terminal coding agent that routes tasks to different large language models by role, such as orchestrator, builder, reviewer, and explorer, through its multi-model orchestration.
en-US.name: Kimchi
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed
New Features
- feat(update): replace on-launch update with background update by @mszostok in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1640
Bug Fixes
- fix(agents): resolve custom agents against session cwd, not process.cwd() by @vmizg in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1680
- perf(work-attribution): delay the first reconciliation pass past startup by @josemonteiro in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1665
- perf(pr-cost): make the idle reporting pass cheap by @josemonteiro in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1672
- perf+fix(pr-cost-reporting): gate reconciler cycles on inputs; settle unrecoverable queue entries by @josemonteiro in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1673
Other Changes
- removing non relevant tips from TUI by @Mahamadou828 in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1692
- NOJIRA: add FOSSA licence scan by @spawlaczykcast in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1697
New Contributors
- @spawlaczykcast made their first contribution in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1697
Full Changelog: https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/compare/v1.30.0...v1.31.0

zh-CN.description: 由多模型编排驱动的终端编码代理。
zh-CN.longDescription: Kimchi 是一款终端编码代理，通过多模型编排按角色（编排者、构建者、审查者、探索者等）将任务路由到不同的大语言模型。
